code:
Equipment Request, approved
  -> contains multiple Requested Items

Rule 1: items over $1,000 need extra IT Asset approval
Rule 2: every approved item needs its own fulfillment task
caption: One Request, several items, two rules to automate without code.

code:
Trigger: Request Approved (Approval = Approved)

Flow Variable: extra_approval_threshold = 1000 (Integer)

Look Up Records: Requested Item where Request = [trigger Number]
  -> output: requested_items_list (multi-record pill)
caption: A constant business rule becomes a variable; related records become a list pill.

steps.label: For Each item
steps.sub: iterates requested_items_list, one current-item pill per pass

steps.label: If: price > threshold
steps.sub: Ask for Approval -> IT Asset Management

steps.label: Create Record (Task)
steps.sub: runs every pass regardless of branch -- one task per item

code:
Request: $400 monitor, $1,500 laptop, $250 headset

For Each runs 3 times:
  $400  -> Else -> task created
  $1,500 -> If -> extra approval -> task created
  $250  -> Else -> task created

Result: 1 approval request, 3 fulfillment tasks
caption: Three items, one loop, the right branch taken every time.
